scope: Ordinary housing typology photographs and construction descriptions, covering the construction periods in the cited report. Welsh slate and stone, Scottish gray/red sandstone and harling, northern English stone and southern brick cannot be represented by an all-UK brick default. Highland rural housing now has a separate reviewed regional record; this does not complete Scottish urban, Welsh or Northern Irish coverage.
